conquered by the "Supreme Overlord"—the 
Path of Supremacy!

text_block_list.text:

never yield to any adversity...!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:

strength?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:

own path. No matter how many times you 
stumble, you never stop your legs.

text_block_list.text:

supremacy"...!
